mutate_comment: Specifying `mutate` REPLACES Stryker's default array, and the default is what excludes *.test.ts. Run 1 of issue #114 forgot the negation and mutated 2665 mutants' worth of the test suite itself.
tsconfigFile_comment: Issue #114: @stryker-mutator/core's TSConfigPreprocessor dynamic-imports typescript and calls ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson, which does not exist under typescript@7.0.2. Pointing tsconfigFile at a file that is not in the project makes project.files.get() miss and the rewrite a no-op. Safe here: tsconfig.json extends a path INSIDE the project and declares no references, so nothing needed rewriting.
plugins_comment: Issue #114: the default glob ['@stryker-mutator/*'] loads no plugins at all under pnpm's symlinked node_modules - the child test-runner process reports 'no TestRunner plugins were loaded'. Naming the plugin explicitly resolves it.
